description: One-call on-chain profile of any Ethereum or Base wallet via Blockscout: native balance, transaction and transfer counts, activity recency, top token holdings, and most frequent recent counterparties — with fresh-wallet and high-volume flags. The 'who is this address?' conclusion, not raw RPC data. Use this when an agent needs to on-chain wallet profile: balance, activity, tokens, counterparties. x402 price $0.005/call (USDC, eip155:8453).
name: crypto_wallet_snapshot
title: Wallet Snapshot (Live)
